title: Siege of the Mechouar of Tlemcen
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of the Mechouar of Tlemcen", at revision 1375444262, opens: "The siege of the mechouar of Tlemcen, the citadel of the city, was led by Emir Abdelkader from 1834 to 1836 against the garrison entrenched within its walls, composed of Turks and Kouloughlis." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q140301345, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1834–1836 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
